column8: The git connector binds an Intent: trailer only when it sits inside git's FINAL trailer block (kernel/internal/connector/git/SPEC.md: "Only a final Git trailer block may populate IntentTrailers"; INV-28 "subject/body mentions never create an intent_refs entry"). By the kernel grammar, 17 of the 30 commits carrying an Intent line have no bindable trailer (14 of them touched governed paths, so the gate demanded a trailer and was satisfied by a body line; 3 touched none) — including the release-line precedent 34af46d and the 2026-11-16 release-line commit a028984 — the Intent: line is a body paragraph separated from Co-Authored-By by a blank line, so proofbound intent check --commit prints intent=none and the Trust Record holds NO claim for them; the other 13 place it correctly and bind (verified: a5a085b resolves to records:CI-staged-pin-guard-7b3c9d@1673422f…). The shell gate scripts/intent-delivery-applicability.sh greps %B for ^Intent: anywhere, so make check is green either way: the harness verifies presence, not binding (Law 9 corollary — a verdict is only as good as its harness). The convention existed and drifted; it was never enforced. No history rewrite is proposed for the 17; they are a known tombstone. FIXED 2026-11-16 (CI-intent-trailer-block-xp2pke, BR-gate-integrity-4b2e08 O-1): the gate now ports the kernel intentTrailers grammar + resolution-time value rule; both parsers are pinned to one shared corpus (scripts/tests/fixtures/intent-trailers, 12 cases) by TestIntentTrailers_SharedCorpus and intent-delivery-applicability.test.sh, each with a demonstrated positive control; on real history the gate refuses a028984 and accepts a5a085b. Condition (3) CHANGED with reason: a live proofbound intent check inside make check needs embedded Postgres + a synced ledger, making the gate environment-dependent (forbidden by O-1); parser parity via the shared corpus replaces it. Status stays OPEN pending a non-author verdict on the gate change (Law 9; the author fixed it and may not accept it). UPDATE 2026-11-16 after review rounds 1-2 (verdicts intent-trailer-gate-review-round1/round2-20261116): round-1 F2 claimed make check never runs the gate on HEAD; round 2 independently reproduced that this was WRONG (delivery-enforce.test.sh runs the real delivery-enforce.sh, whose gate call defaults to HEAD). Round 2 still NEEDS_WORK: (F1) more parser-boundary mutants survive on both sides; (F2, the material one) the gate checks only HEAD, and the commit-then-refresh-the-pin pattern puts a non-governed commit on top of every governed one, so make check never sees the governed commit; (F3) nothing asserts delivery-enforce invokes the gate, and its self-test fails silently; (F4) iconv accepts some sequences the kernel rejects, and author/path bytes are unchecked. column8: A change intent can never supersede an earlier revision of itself. kernel/internal/connector/intent/intent.go validates a change intent's targets, constrained_by, and supersedes as ONE list that must ascend strictly by key (source, record_kind, record_id, digest, relation); every change intent needs at least one target, targets are requirement references, and a supersedes reference to an earlier change-intent revision has record_kind change_intent, which sorts before requirement, so the combined list always descends and is rejected (intent: invalid reference). Requirements escape this only by luck (business_decision sorts before requirement). Found 2026-11-16 when extending CI-intent-trailer-block-xp2pke's scope; worked around with a NEW intent (CI-intent-trailer-range-gwi9uu). No change intent in the repository has a second revision, so this has never fired before. Kernel defect in the canonical model, not fixed: it changes intent-SPEC validation and needs its own spec amendment and non-author review.
